data.why: Superdry's entry into Argentina is a recent international retail expansion from late October 2026. For an interim CFO, opening physical stores in a new country creates immediate payables complexity with unfamiliar local suppliers and tax formats.
data.angle: Retail expansion into a new country creates new vendor relationships, store fit-out bills, and cross-border invoice processing volume.

not_chosen.reason: Bad news: Co-founder criminal verdict and rape conviction.
The $94M debt refinancing is recent, but large financing news is the generic hook every sales rep uses.
Hiring an AP Assistant shows payables volume across entities, but citing an individual junior opening is too tactical for an interim CFO.
General store expansion plans in Europe are vague compared to the concrete launch in Argentina.
A tech executive leaving for Burberry is unrelated to finance and awkward to mention.

data.subject: argentina store
data.body:
Hi Greg,

Superdry opened its first store in Argentina. Expanding retail into a new country usually brings a wave of new local suppliers, store buildout costs, and bills in different formats. Who is matching and keying all those invoices into the system today?

Mindbody processes 95%+ of invoices end to end with Zamp.

Worth a look?

[Your name]
